name: Claiming Arathi Basin
summary: An Alliance Brigadier General outside Arathi Basin asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor. The marks are what the general requests from you.

faq.answer: An Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

faq.q: How many Marks of Honor are needed?
faq.answer: The general asks you to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor.

faq.q: Where do I bring the marks?
faq.answer: Bring the marks to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you are asked to bring three Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General.
